# Plan: Add `CHANGELOG.md`

## Goal Description

Add a root-level `CHANGELOG.md` file to `/tmp/agy-capture-plan-t1A0um` to provide a structured, human-readable record of notable changes to the project.

During inspection, the workspace directory was found to be **empty** and **not initialized as a Git repository** (no existing files, manifests, commit history, or version tags). Because there is no existing history to backfill, the plan establishes a clean baseline using the [Keep a Changelog 1.1.0](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) convention and [Semantic Versioning 2.0.0](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> No files in the workspace directory will be created or modified until you approve this plan and confirm how you would like to handle the open questions below.

> [!NOTE]
> Because the directory has no Git repository, package manifest (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, etc.), or tags, version numbers and comparison links cannot be inferred automatically and will start from a template baseline unless you provide them.

## Open Questions

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Please confirm your preferences on the following before execution:
> 1. **Initial section**: Should the changelog start with only an `[Unreleased]` section, or should it also include an initial versioned entry (e.g., `[0.1.0] - 2026-11-19`)?
> 2. **Format standard**: Is [Keep a Changelog 1.1.0](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) + SemVer preferred, or do you want a different format (e.g., Conventional Commits / `standard-version` / `changesets` compatible)?
> 3. **Repository comparison links**: Do you have a Git remote URL (e.g., `https://github.com/<org>/<repo>`) to wire up `[Unreleased]` and version comparison links at the bottom of the file, or should those be omitted for now?

---

## Proposed Changes

### Root Documentation

Create a single root-level `CHANGELOG.md` following Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 conventions:

- Title and brief convention header referencing Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning.
- An `[Unreleased]` section at the top for tracking upcoming changes, grouped by standard change categories (`Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed`, `Security`).
- Optional initial release section (if confirmed) using ISO 8601 date formatting (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- Optional reference-style comparison links at the bottom of the file once a repository URL and tags exist.

#### [NEW] CHANGELOG.md

Target path: `/tmp/agy-capture-plan-t1A0um/CHANGELOG.md`

```markdown
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Initial `CHANGELOG.md` to track project changes.
```

*(If an initial versioned release and repository URL are specified during review, the `[Unreleased]` entry above will be placed under `## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-19` with a reference-link footer such as `[unreleased]: <repo-url>/compare/v0.1.0...HEAD` and `[0.1.0]: <repo-url>/releases/tag/v0.1.0`.)*

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests

No test suite currently exists in the directory. After creating the file (once approved), run structural and formatting checks:

```bash
# Confirm CHANGELOG.md exists and is the only file added
ls -la

# Verify non-empty UTF-8 Markdown content and expected headings
file CHANGELOG.md
grep -E '^#{1,3} ' CHANGELOG.md
```

### Manual Verification

1. Review the rendered Markdown of `CHANGELOG.md` to verify heading hierarchy (`#` → `##` → `###`), spelling, and valid links.
2. Confirm that the initial section (`[Unreleased]` vs. versioned release) and any repository comparison URLs match your answers to the Open Questions.
